response.overview: # English Translation  It tells the story of the struggles and life challenges that a beautiful girl named Suri (played by Ernie Zakri) must face, who is very passionate about dance art, but cannot continue her studies due to financial constraints. After the death of her parents, the situation becomes increasingly urgent, so Suri decides to marry Tuan Syed Sadiq (played by Hasnul Rahmat), the former employer of her late mother who has helped them greatly over the years. Suri is also pursued by her village friend Faizal (played by Zul Huzaimy). Suri's mother's death is related to Farid. After getting married, Suri moves and her life becomes quite different from before. She returns as Kat (played by Umi Nazeera), who wants to seek justice for what happened to her and her mother. The secret of her mother's death and the secret of the change in her are eventually revealed, and at that time Suri's life continues to be burdened with trials.
response.title: Suri Katriana (Astro Prima)
